name: tastemaker
title_zh: 把参考图变成同风格 UI 代码，告别 AI 味
tagline_zh: 粘贴 Pinterest/Dribbble 链接或截图，它就能拆解配色、字体、间距、质感，生成真正有品牌感的界面。
tagline_en: Paste a Pinterest/Dribbble link or screenshot — it extracts colors, type, spacing, and texture to ship on-brand.
desc_en: Generate genuinely beautiful, on-brand UI instead of generic "AI slop" — use whenever the user asks to build, design, style, or improve a UI, landing page, dashboard, app screen, or component, whenever a PRD/spec needs a design pass before implementation, whenever the user pastes reference images/Pinterest/Dribbble links and wants the app to look like them, or whenever the user complains the AI-ge
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是逐层解析参考图的视觉语法，再映射到可维护的 Tailwind/组件代码。
why_en: It doesn't apply templates — it parses the visual grammar of your reference and maps it into maintainable Tailwind/component.
limit_zh: 只认静态视觉参考（截图/链接），不处理动效或交互规范；产物是前端代码，不含设计系统文档；复杂设计需人工微调。
limit_en: Only static visual refs (screenshots/links); no motion or interaction specs. Output is frontend code, not design-system docs; complex designs need.
